answer: At a pearl auction in the harbor, each reward claim must include a hashcash stamp bound to the wallet, task digest and a fresh epoch beacon. The wharf verifier checks a published difficulty target and rejects reused stamps. A farm cannot reuse one search across a thousand names: each claim consumes additional hashing, electricity and hardware time. Difficulty must make that cost meaningful relative to the reward, with no signup bonus to harvest. This prices claims without proving unique owners; cheap power and specialized chips still favor rich attackers.
